scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
eligibility_text: Any bank or post-office account holder aged 18 to 50 at enrolment (cover continues to age 55 on renewal), with consent for annual auto-debit.
benefits: Rs 2 lakh life cover for death by any cause. Annual premium Rs 436, auto-debited each June.
source_note: Verified Sep 2026 — premium is Rs 436/year (revised from Rs 330 in June 2022).
